primer: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: VRTX) is an orphan-disease compounder anchored by a cystic fibrosis monopoly protected through 2037–2039. Despite COMPOUNDER_PASS business quality, our forensic audit flagged $8.52B in Crinetics intangibles ($5.12B atumelnant IPR&D), $4.5B in floating-rate SOFR debt, and 2027 legacy LOEs. At $515.02 (2026-11-20 Stage 3 close) to $532.81 (2026-11-23 Stage 2 snapshot), VRTX trades at 42.17x P/FCF against our $500.00 Base Target (Bear $292.00, EV $460.60). We assign REJECTED (TIER_0) on valuation and Downtrend macro conditions.
